# HODY

> HODY is the technology consulting practice of Hodahel Moinzadeh ("Hody"), an AI
> Systems Engineer. HODY offers IT & technology consulting, AI consulting and setup,
> systems automation and development, DevOps, and custom software development.

## Key facts

- Services: IT/technology consulting; AI consulting & setup; systems automation &

- Area served: Worldwide (remote)
- Contact: contact form at https://hody.dev
- Related: portfolio https://hodahelmoinzadeh.com · GitHub https://github.com/hodyhq

## What HODY is known for
Practical, ship-it AI integration and infrastructure automation — building systems
that run themselves, with a focus on reliability, identity/security, and clean DevOps.
